apply_steps: Read selected CHK2 keys, clear category/legend CHECKED flags.
For each selected row, match SUB_GUBUN to category and legend arrays; set matching CHECKED true and category/legend presence flags.
If no category DATA_TYPE1 exists, require legend flag; otherwise require both category and legend flags. Failure alerts resource MSG00962 or MSG10056 and returns.
Convert unchecked false flags to null; send message with categoryData,legendData,checkedList and callback=this.close.bind(this); then close.

grouping_and_numeric.facts: Index X1 by K-E-Y; iterate each Y list and join matching X by K-E-Y. Category key is formatted X1 caption; groupId is formatted X2 when provided or synthetic GROUPn per Y otherwise. Same formatted category/group accumulates numeric values. First occurrence builds category/series order. Pie path takes absolute value of each contributing Y before sum. Original source-ID grouping equality is not established.

Without comparator, distinct formatted X2 values become category rows and distinct formatted X1 values become series. Join lists by K-E-Y and sum Y1 for each combination; missing combinations get0. With comparator, combine formatted X1 + space/slash/space + X2 as category and sum Y1 into one GROUPID0 series before ranking.

Ordinary path builds all distinct formatted X1/X2 combinations with zero series values, then joins Y lists by K-E-Y and accumulates; category text orders X2/X1. Ranked path uses combined X1 / X2 caption and sum of both Y fields through getTwoByTwoHighestData; grouping/ordering differs from unranked formatting. Caption concatenation is not a guaranteed collision-free SID tuple.

Undefined/null/non-number-convertible Y becomes0, otherwise Number(value). Falsey X or empty-placeholder caption maps to resource LBL03552; otherwise external convertor/value-format helper. Current company-specific format/defaults remain unknown.

Separate array-oriented helper algorithms also exist. createTwoByDataSource aligns X/Y lists by index rather than K-E-Y; do not combine that helper contract with ECChart option path without a concrete caller.

actual_top_bottom10.option_1x1_1x2_2x1: If comparatorPropName truthy, sortOfECChart scores each category by sum of values whose sortKey equals comparatorPropName. isShowHighest truthy -> DESC, otherwise ASC. Then i=i.splice(0,10), retaining at most10 category rows after grouping. isShowLowest is not directly read in new graph.data body; retained common consumer creates comparatorPropName under high/low flags.
actual_top_bottom10.ties: sortOfECChart reverses input before DESC sort and, on equal score, calls sortByDate(category,...,direction), extracting numeric year/month/day by regex. No general non-date lexical tie key or company-calendar rule is established.
actual_top_bottom10.option_2x2_ranked: getTwoByTwoHighestData aggregates combined X captions then calls getHighestData. That helper lodash-sortBy(prop), then for highest takes lastN and reverses, otherwise firstN. N=10. This is a separate tie policy from sortOfECChart; do not impose a single tie formula on every matrix.
actual_top_bottom10.ordering_of_filter: Retained common createChartOption calls data option builder first, then getChartOptionFilter. Therefore local grouping/ranking precedes selection/color filtering in this connected code path. Popup options derived from origin_graph_config.datas can already be limited to ranked categories; popup does not search all backend rows.
actual_top_bottom10.pie_other: 1x1 optional pieAllothersPercentage combines low-percentage groups into others before comparator ranking; source cutoff test uses percentage>threshold. Exact popup threshold validation/current config unknown.
actual_top_bottom10.30_confirm: Retained inventory guard is total_count>=30 && is_graph && empty comparatorColumn; confirmation itself does not perform top10 selection. Keep UI recommendation and actual ranking conditions distinct.
